name: Independent vertical water riser
pressure_basis: Total pressure (static + velocity), with elevation potential handled separately; common reference. Not an ambient-referenced vertical air pressure model.
scope: Prescribed withdrawals in a constant-density, fully filled circular tree; no loops or pressure-dependent flow solution
pending: noise, cavitation, compressibility and domain/code checks

sources.test: Explicit synthetic test inputs: 5 m vertical rise, prescribed 1 L/s water flow, 998 kg/m3 and 0.001 Pa s; 180 kPa supply total pressure, 100 kPa required outlet total pressure, K=3, 2 m/s target. Not measured, manufacturer or regulatory data.
